title: The visual system of the Australian 'Redeye' cicada (Psaltoda moerens)
why: The record page gives about 7500 ommatidia per eye, 10-15 degrees frontal and 50-60 degrees dorsal binocular overlap and facet lens diameters of 22-34 um in a cicada; the full text may give facet geometry or an interommatidial angle for the one measured cicada, the nearest relative of Cicada orni in any source found.
get: journal via library (Arthropod Struct Dev 44:574); repository record at openresearch-repository.anu.edu.au is embargoed until 2037
